comparison.a: B01A is feasible and includes acceptance tests and governance policy, but milestones are higher-level with less explicit test coverage mapping and less detailed operationalization.
comparison.b: B01B is feasible and more operationally detailed, with granular milestones, explicit acceptance-test coverage mapping, and clearer governance linkage, improving execution and testability.

evidence.note: B01B provides granular milestone structure with deliverables and exit criteria per stage.
B01A uses a single high-level milestone with aggregated exit criteria, less granular for execution tracking.
B01B explicitly maps acceptance tests to milestones, improving test coverage traceability.
B01A lists acceptance tests but lacks explicit milestone-to-test coverage analysis.
B01B explicitly sets high HITL strictness tied to branch governance posture.
B01A includes comprehensive HITL policy but does not explicitly connect it to branch posture in decision log.
B01B acknowledges big-bang budget risk explicitly in warnings.
B01A notes blocking open questions but less specific about big-bang budget risk.

payload.notes: Winner B01B for stronger testability and operational feasibility due to explicit milestone structure and acceptance-test coverage mapping, while maintaining comparable governance and architecture to B01A.
